# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201) from India

**Embedded emissions = 1,266.27 tCO2e**

## Input Check

| Required input | Provided | In table? |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | ✅ Yes |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Yes, listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 500.5 tonnes | ✅ Yes |

All required inputs are present, so a definitive figure can be computed.

## Factor Selection

The SEE is selected by CN code and country together:

- CN 7201, India: **2.53 tCO2e/t**

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e

Rounded to 2 decimal places using standard half-up rounding, this is **1,266.27 tCO2e**.

The ruleset does not specify a rounding convention. Under round-half-to-even (banker's rounding), the result would be 1,266.26 tCO2e.
